{{Top|leg}}
'''Laser light generators''' were large pieces of machinery that were necessary to unlock the content of an [[Optical Information Crystal]]. That machine would emit a powerful [[Laser/Legends|laser]] beam, which the operator needed to redirect right on the crystal by adjusting the angle of a [[Mirror/Legends|mirror]].
